newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt asks Israel to "come to its senses".
newsitem.headline: Egypt asks Israel to "come to its senses".

text.p: Egypt called on the Israeli government on Monday to come to its senses and carry out its agreements with the Palestinians.
Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri, in an aside in a 90-minute statement to parliament, said Israel would eventually be the prime beneficiary from Middle East peace.

"Today we call on the Israeli government to return to the right way, come to its senses, and go back to implementing the agreements made with the Palestinian Authority under the auspices of the international community," he said.
"When peace prevails and development prospers, Israel will learn that this is in its interests first and foremost."
Ganzouri devoted most of his speech to internal economic matters and did not go into the latest developments in Israeli-Palestinian talks on the West Bank town of Hebron.
U.S. special envoy Dennis Ross, who has been mediating in those talks, would meet Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa on Monday afternoon, official sources said.
